description: This file contains functions for generating and configuring radio and PHY settings for a software-defined radio (SDR) system, specifically related to 3GPP specifications and RU (Radio Unit) configurations. It includes functions for creating lower PHY configurations, parsing driver arguments, calibrating frequencies, and generating overall SDR configurations.

methods.name: generate_lower_phy_config
methods.description: Creates a lower PHY configuration based on RU and cell configurations, including frequency, bandwidth, and buffer policies.

methods.name: split_rf_driver_args
methods.description: Splits a driver argument string into a vector of individual arguments.

methods.name: extract_zmq_ports
methods.description: Extracts ZMQ port addresses from driver argument strings based on a port identifier.

methods.name: calibrate_center_freq_Hz
methods.description: Calibrates a center frequency in Hz considering frequency offset and PPM calibration.

methods.name: generate_radio_config
methods.description: Generates radio configuration including frequencies, gain, and ZMQ addresses for each sector and cell.

methods.name: generate_ru_sdr_config
methods.description: Generates the complete SDR configuration for a RU, including PHY, radio, and metrics settings.

methods.name: fill_sdr_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Fills the worker manager configuration with SDR-related settings based on RU configuration.
